description:
Your Amazon business has a story. Ask sellerfox.

Connect your sellerfox account to ChatGPT and turn your Amazon data into answers you can act on. Explore what drives your sales, which products contribute most to your profit and how your advertising is performing — simply by asking.

Compare periods, explore cost breakdowns and connect the dots between sales, traffic, search performance and keyword rankings. Dig deeper with follow-up questions to understand what’s working, what’s changing and what deserves your attention.

Requires a sellerfox account with connected Amazon data.

defaultPrompt: Compare the last 30 days with the previous 30. Chart profit and costs, explain changes, and recommend actions.
Find search growth opportunities for my top five products. Chart the funnel and rank actions to improve conversion.
Investigate my five biggest sales declines. Chart traffic, conversion, and rankings, then recommend recovery actions.
